objectives: The objective of this course is to introduce students to the concepts and theory behind the finite element method and its application to civil engineering structures.
content:
1. Introduction
2. Calculus of variations and applications
3. Variational methods of approximation
4. Finite element analysis of one-dimensional problems
5. Finite element analysis of two-dimensional problems
6. Nonlinear Analysis
books: An introduction to the finite element method; J.N. Reddy
